output.reason: The linked PR [ev-a42bf00d3581] says the fix is that the Helm connect page "should not perform type checking when bearerToken is not set". So the subject is the bearerToken validation in the UI's Helm repository connect form, and the change is that the field is no longer validated when it is empty. The only file changed is the UI file ui/src/app/settings/components/repos-list/repos-list.tsx [ev-d7daab778767, ev-912017649c04], and the release item [ev-368a59fe5b7d] is a cherry-pick of that fix [ev-487ab635a2f1]. That makes exposure limited to UI users connecting Helm repos without a bearer token, and since it is a UI bugfix with no stated operator action, the consequence is benign. The exact old symptom (implied: an empty field was being validated) is only shown in videos that are not included, hence low confidence.
